title: Wind Resource Assessment at 120m/150m Hub Heights & State Potential Atlas
agency: National Institute of Wind Energy (NIWE), Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
description: Comprehensive wind power density and capacity utilization factor benchmarks across Indian states.

Tamil Nadu.basis: Muppandal / Kayathar Pass Zone I high-yield coastal wind corridor

Karnataka.basis: Chitradurga / Gadag central Karnataka high-wind plateau

Andhra Pradesh.basis: Rayalaseema wind corridor (Ananthapur / Kadapa Class II resource)

Maharashtra.basis: Western Ghats ridge sites (Satara / Sangli hills adjacent to Pune)

Telangana.basis: Inland low-wind resource (marginal commercial feasibility for utility scale)

Uttar Pradesh.basis: Not viable (wind power density <100 W/m2 in Gangetic plains; zero commercial potential)

West Bengal.basis: Not viable (wind power density <100 W/m2 in Gangetic delta; non-commercial onshore wind)

Gujarat.basis: Coastal Saurashtra / Gulf of Kutch / Jamnagar Class I wind corridor (120m/150m hub height)
